purpose: Two alternate natural hairstyles per hero, all eight on one concept sheet.
prompt:
Create ONE beautifully organized HAIRSTYLE CONCEPT SHEET for the original Bloomlings garden game, featuring EXACTLY EIGHT large HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS PORTRAITS: TWO DIFFERENT HAIRSTYLES for EACH of FOUR heroes. Use supplied reference images to preserve the heroes' approved cute faces, eye shapes, big-head proportions, colors and premium soft sculpted 3D game style. Reference 1 is Sprig, reference 2 shows Bloom, Drop, Twig. This sheet proposes new cosmetic hairstyles, not hats or outfits.

LAYOUT: clean 2 ROWS by 4 COLUMNS on warm ivory background, subtle spacious separators, generous margins around every leaf, petal or curl, all 8 silhouettes fully visible. Column headings SPRIG, BLOOM, DROP, TWIG across top. Each column has same hero twice with exactly the SAME FACE, same cheerful smile and same head scale; ONLY the natural hair/crown arrangement changes. Straight front view, upright heads, huge glossy expressive eyes, tiny nose and soft blush, little glimpse of original shoulders/collar. Hairstyles occupy enough space to judge silhouette. Small discreet hairstyle names under portraits (specified below). No body outfits, no props, no hats added as merchandise, no hairstyle tools or combs, no floating parts, no arrows, no background scenery. No reference to another franchise.

ART DIRECTION: charming premium stylized 3D sculpted heads, crisp large readable shapes, gently rounded edges, clean satin surfaces, luminous gentle studio lighting, controlled glossy eyes. Hair is made of EACH HERO'S OWN NATURAL MATERIAL (leaves, petals, sculpted water, smooth bark). NO human strand hair, wigs, eyelashes makeup, realistic noisy veins, realistic hair fibers, fuzzy moss, tiny busy details, aggressive sharp spikes, cluttered flowers or jewelry. Keep all faces uncovered: hair never crosses eyes. The two looks per hero differ CLEARLY IN SHAPE AND SILHOUETTE, not merely color. Same hero identity, no completely new species. Keep cute wide softly rounded-square face shapes from references for Sprig/Bloom/Twig and the lovable aqua water-drop head for Drop.

EXACT EIGHT DESIGNS BY CELL:

TOP ROW, COL 1 SPRIG "Leaf Bob": a compact rounded leafy bob, broad green leaves overlapping like a soft scalloped bowl around top and temples. Front fringe has three short rounded leaf tips, softly parted near center above eyebrows, sides end around cheeks with two wide little outward leaves. Low and wide silhouette, NOT original tall swept leaf crest. Sculpted broad shallow veins only; pale pistachio face unchanged. A coherent fitted leaf hair shell, not a loose wreath.

BOTTOM ROW, COL 1 SPRIG "Sprout Quiff": a playful TALL UPWARD crest of three large thick leaf locks growing together from crown, central leaf taller and gently curving forward, two shorter leaves leaning outward. Sides short and swept upward/back, forehead open. Clearly taller and narrower hairstyle than Leaf Bob. Fresh grass green, broad simplified veins, soft rounded leaf tips, no razor spikes. Not a crown made of many thin blades.

TOP ROW, COL 2 BLOOM "Petal Buns": arrange thick rose-pink petals into TWO SMALL ROUND ROSETTE BUNS high on left and right of head. Each bun constructed from just a few broad overlapping rounded petals in a compact spiral. A short soft petal fringe across forehead and smaller petals behind temples connect the buns into a coherent flower hairstyle. Retain the tiny cream-and-yellow forehead flower, same pale pink face and dark brown eyes. Clearly two-lobed hairstyle, not a full radial spiky petal halo. Buns made from petals, not fur or human hair.

BOTTOM ROW, COL 2 BLOOM "Petal Bob": a flowing asymmetrical FLOWER-PETAL BOB. Three broad rose petals form a smooth side-swept fringe above eyebrows, layered petal locks cascade to cheek height on each side, one side slightly longer. Rounded petal tips and subtle thick curled edges, softly domed low crown. Preserve tiny cream flower near parting and original pale pink face. Hair-shaped petals, not the original radial flower halo, no ribbon or hat. Distinct from double buns.

TOP ROW, COL 3 DROP "Wave Curl": keep reference aqua DROP-SHAPED HEAD and same face, reshape its upper pointed crown into ONE broad smooth SURFER WAVE CURL, sweeping to one side and curling back toward center. Curl ends as a thick rounded water lobe with a clear shallow open curl silhouette, NOT a separate rigid hat stuck on top. Lower head stays full rounded droplet cheeks. One or two broad flowing sculpted ridges unite curl with crown. Blue opaque pearly satin, no transparent glass, no realistic splash particles, no bubbles. One continuous stylized water hairstyle.

BOTTOM ROW, COL 3 DROP "Twin Ripples": same large aqua rounded droplet HEAD and face, but TWO SHORT CURLING WATER LOCKS rise from upper left/right sides, forming neat symmetrical little rounded ripple tufts. A small central droplet point remains visible between them so identity stays water drop. Each side tuft is one thick simple water lobe curling gently outward/upward, connected seamlessly to crown, no floating water. A gentle shallow curved forehead ripple unites them. Clearly two small side tufts rather than one big surfer curl. Clean simple solid forms, no translucent spheres or separate hair ties.

TOP ROW, COL 4 TWIG "Bark Curls": original honey-gold acorn hero with familiar chestnut acorn cap, short stem and one green leaf retained. Beneath the cap rim, three short smooth rounded BARK CURLS form a soft forehead fringe and a few plump coiled bark locks frame temples. Curls are broad stylized warm caramel wood shavings, modestly thick with smooth ends and only a shallow center groove; not thin twig branches, not realistic hair. Cap remains slightly above forehead, face stays open, rounded curly side silhouette visibly different from reference. No extra acorns, no sharp branches.

BOTTOM ROW, COL 4 TWIG "Bark Sweep": same honey-gold face, acorn cap with stem and leaf, but cap sits gently tilted toward back to reveal a prominent SIDE-SWEPT WOODEN QUIFF underneath its front rim. Three broad tapered smooth bark locks sweep together diagonally across upper forehead ABOVE eyebrows, ending in soft rounded points; sides form short tidy swept-back bark pieces. Cleaner angular swept silhouette versus round Bark Curls, no tight coils. Warm chestnut/caramel tones, soft sculpted wood planes, no fine grain, no human hair strands, no extra hat or crown.

Make the eight concepts visually appealing, cohesive and readable as actual possible alternate head hair meshes for these four specific heroes. Names exactly: Leaf Bob, Sprout Quiff, Petal Buns, Petal Bob, Wave Curl, Twin Ripples, Bark Curls, Bark Sweep. Large portraits, little text, face consistency within each column.
